title: Duolingo: answer and character feedback
role_for_mira: Tactile/game-feel reference for action acknowledgment across all three surfaces.

provenance.kind: keyframes from official animated GIF; GIF cadence is not device performance

target_reference.units: logical design units, not measured donor dp

spatial_ergonomic.measurement_basis: Qualitative visual reading of retained frames. Regions below are relative roles; source screenshots/GIFs do not expose device density or reliable native dp. Marketing/device chrome is not counted as app content.

regions.description: Top: progress and prompt; center: character and constructed answer; lower area: selectable words and Check.
The character reacts and a local bottom feedback region appears; Continue remains in the lower action area.

spatial_ergonomic.reference_zone_status: Proposed comparison grid only; donor controls may fall outside these bands. Not a fixed-coordinate implementation rule.

visual_density.value: Exercise: medium; local feedback: low; multiple word options increase lower-area density.

states_and_triggers.limitation: Visible states are observations; documented arrows use source flow/guide descriptions. No event-handler names, gesture thresholds, or unseen screens are inferred as measured behavior.

observation.value: The GIF visibly changes selected tokens, action availability, character pose, and feedback region. Its 4.62-second encoded sequence is not a native performance benchmark or prescribed Mira duration.

visual_or_documented_feedback.value: The visual character reaction and local feedback region are observed. The GIF does not contain audible cues or haptic traces.

hierarchy.value: A task instruction stays separate from the response and completion feedback. Feedback does not replace the screen with a long explanation.

copy_and_cognitive_load.note: No OCR word-count or grade-level measurement is claimed. Use the Mira copy sheet for exact comparison text.

mira_synthesis_candidate.value: Use a rich, recognizable illustration world and satisfying state changes. Respond to an action or confirmed save; never label feelings right/wrong or celebrate before persistence succeeds. Keep controls usable during nonessential animation.
